messages:
yana: Quick doc sync 8: putting together minimal retry + trim examples for the error ref (429, timeouts, context-too-long). need owner for PR and a smoke job.

yana: Scope: one JS snippet (Retry-After or backoff + jitter, max attempts), one Python snippet (trim oldest convo pairs until under token limit), and a 1-line fallback note about smaller model changes.

omar: i can review and check wording. please include a clear `MAX_ATTEMPTS` constant.

kai: i'll wire the CI smoke using the existing snippet-runner workflow. need branch by EOD.

yana: perfect. i'll open a tiny PR in docs/err-ref and tag you both.

omar: small nit: add explicit "do not retry on 400-499 except 429".

kai: also show how to parse Retry-After safely (base 10) and fallback to backoff when header missing.

yana: added those notes in the draft and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 - "minimal retry & trim examples"

docs-bot: CI: lint passed.

kai: smoke job added and passed on branch yana/minimal-retry-trim.

omar: looks good to me, approved.

yana: merging. will add a short migration blurb for customers relying on implicit retries.

docs-bot: PR merged.

yana: thanks all "
